title: Encore service template metadata
description: The meta.json of a service template under services/. The template's id is the name of its directory.

$schema.description: The path to this schema, for editors.

title.description: A short human-readable name, shown in the template picker.

description.description: What the service does, in a sentence or two. Shown in the picker and used to match the template against what a user asks for, so say what it is for rather than how it is built.

lang.description: The language the service is written in. The same value as "lang" in its encore.service.json.

category.description: Which section of the template picker it is listed in: "integration" for a third-party service such as Stripe, Resend or Slack; "framework" for a web framework or library such as FastAPI, Django or Prisma; "demo" for one that shows what Encore itself does, such as Pub/Sub or cron.

framework.description: The web framework or library the service is built on, if any, such as "express" or "axum". Leave it out for the standard library.

tags.description: Lowercase keywords for what the service uses or does, such as "http", "postgres", "pubsub" or "webhooks".
